title: Moving customers off COD leaves their $0 limit as it is
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Due on Receipt is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure COD is held by customer A (made for this test), with a $0.00 limit.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "COD" row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Select None".
  4. Type customer A's name in "Search customers".
  5. Tick customer A.
  6. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  7. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  8. Open Edit Customer for customer A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from COD" opens.

Step 3:

  • "0 selected" (every customer on the term is unticked, including those not in view).

Step 4:

  • Only customer A is listed.

Step 5:

  • The count reads "1 selected".

Step 6:

  • No $0 line shows.

Step 7:

  • No confirmation opens and the toast "1 customer moved to Net 30." shows.

Step 8:

  • Credit Terms reads Net 30 and Credit Limit reads $0.00, now editable.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S4-E3: “Moving customers to COD or Credit Hold sets each moved customer's credit limit to $0 (S4-R16), whatever limit they had, and keeps the previous limit in each note (S4-R20). Moving customers off COD or Credit Hold to another term leaves their $0 limit as it is until someone enters a new one in Edit Customer.”
  • S4-R17: “When "Move To" is any other term, no confirmation opens, and each moved customer's credit limit stays as it was.”
  • S5-R5: “For any other term, Credit Limit is editable, as on Edit Customer today. Switching from COD or Credit Hold to another term leaves the limit at $0.00 until the user enters one.”
